purpose: Post-11-May-2026 Dungeoneering Remastered reward gates that materially affect League combat, prayer sustain, Summoning supply and Herblore progression. This overlay supersedes pre-remaster token costs for the listed rewards.

policy.region_rule: Daemonheim and Dungeoneering are a hard Forinthry dependency in this project.

account_additions.name: Bonecrusher
account_additions.effect: Configured bone drops are automatically converted into the Prayer experience that burying those bones would give.
account_additions.synergy: Prayer-restoring Dungeoneering necklaces can restore Prayer points from bones processed by the Bonecrusher.
account_additions.historical_correction: Before the 11 May 2026 remaster the Bonecrusher cost 34,000 tokens and had a lower Dungeoneering requirement. Do not restore those values.

account_additions.name: Charming imp
account_additions.effect: Automatically collects dropped charms and spirit gems; selected charm types can instead be converted into a small amount of Summoning experience.
account_additions.historical_correction: The 11 May 2026 remaster reduced the cost from 100,000 to 50,000 tokens and changed the Dungeoneering requirement to 41.

account_additions.name: Herbicide
account_additions.effect: Configured grimy herb drops are destroyed instead of received, granting twice the normal cleaning experience for those herbs.
account_additions.historical_correction: The 11 May 2026 remaster increased the cost from 34,000 to 50,000 tokens and changed the Dungeoneering requirement to 41.

equipment_additions.name: Split dragontooth necklace
equipment_additions.effect_summary: Restores Prayer points when qualifying bones are buried; works with bones processed by the Bonecrusher.
equipment_additions.historical_correction: The remaster reduced the token cost from 17,000 to 15,500 and the Dungeoneering requirement from 60 to 41; the 60 Prayer requirement remains a separate equipment gate.

equipment_additions.name: Demon horn necklace
equipment_additions.effect_summary: Restores 50–150 Prayer points when qualifying bones are buried or supported ashes/ghosts are absorbed with the attuned ectoplasmator.
equipment_additions.historical_correction: The remaster kept the 35,000-token cost but reduced the Dungeoneering requirement from 90 to 75.

equipment_additions.name: Amulet of zealots
equipment_additions.effect_summary: Increases the effect of supported single-stat boosting prayers by 10% while imposing a Prayer bonus penalty.
equipment_additions.historical_correction: The remaster kept the 40,000-token cost and reduced the Dungeoneering requirement from 48 to 38.

consumable_additions.name: Meilyr potion recipe page purchase
consumable_additions.effect: Provides the Dungeoneering reward-shop route for a Meilyr combination-potion recipe page before the corresponding recipe is bought from Lady Meilyr.
consumable_additions.historical_correction: The 11 May 2026 remaster reduced this reward-shop cost from 500,000 to 100,000 Dungeoneering tokens; the Dungeoneering requirement remained 75.
consumable_additions.league_treatment: This is one recipe-page acquisition route. Keep the permanent Lady Meilyr recipe purchase and Tirannwn access as separate dependencies.
